description: The supported openCypher profile (v1) and why each openCypher TCK 2024.2 scenario that does not pass fails. `scripts/run-opencypher-tck.py` assigns every failure the first matching rule's category; a failure no rule matches keeps a runner category that is not listed here, which fails the run. An `exclusion` is a feature outside the supported profile, reported by capability discovery (its `limitations`). A `defect` is a wrong result of the Grafeo openCypher implementation RushDB embeds; RushDB does not patch Grafeo, and CI reruns every defect on plain Grafeo so a failure RushDB causes cannot hide here. Cypher stays release candidate while any defect remains.

lmpg-single-label.description: LMPG records carry exactly one primary label: nodes without a label or with several, and statement label changes other than no-ops (SET n:L, REMOVE n:L), are refused. Change a record's label with the native retypeRecord mutation.

procedures.description: CALL procedures: the embedded engine is built without its procedure (algos) feature, and the TCK's test procedures are not registered.

temporal.description: The openCypher temporal type system: the local/zoned distinction, named time zones, nanosecond precision, week/ordinal/quarter constructors and the truncate/between/inSeconds functions. date(), time(), datetime() and duration() from ISO 8601 text work and return ISO 8601 text.

grafeo-error-detection.description: The TCK expects a compile-time or runtime error Grafeo does not raise (it accepts the statement).

grafeo-syntax.description: openCypher syntax Grafeo's parser does not accept.

grafeo-semantic.description: Grafeo's binder refuses a valid statement (scope of variables, OPTIONAL MATCH without input, DELETE of expressions).

grafeo-internal.description: Grafeo fails the statement with an internal error.

grafeo-write-column-names.description: Write statements name projected aggregates and functions differently from the expression text (count(...) for count(*)).

grafeo-lazy-writes.description: A LIMIT or SKIP after an updating clause also limits the updates (writes are not eager).

grafeo-result.description: Grafeo returns a different result (rows, order, values or null handling).

grafeo-nontermination.description: The statement does not finish (a variable-length match around a cycle); the server cancels it at the request deadline.

rules.confirmed: Grafeo expands an empty variable-length interval (*2..1, *..0). Plain Grafeo returns the same rows for a single MATCH; it passes the TCK's two-MATCH form only through a different join plan.

rules.pattern: require exactly one label|one primary label|label mutation is unavailable
